status-hook.sh.content:
#!/bin/sh
EVENT="${1:-poll}"
PORT_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/port"
TOKEN_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/cli-token"
[ -f "$PORT_FILE" ] || exit 0
[ -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ] || exit 0
PORT=$(cat "$PORT_FILE")
TOKEN=$(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")
AT=$(date +%s%3N 2>/dev/null)
case "$AT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) AT="" ;; esac

NOTIFICATION_TYPE=""
if [ "$EVENT" = "notification" ]; then
  NOTIFICATION_TYPE=$(sed -n 's/.*"notification_type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
fi

(
  SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}' 2>/dev/null) || SESSION=""
  PAYLOAD="{\"event\":\"${EVENT}\",\"session\":\"${SESSION}\""
  if [ -n "$NOTIFICATION_TYPE" ]; then
    PAYLOAD="${PAYLOAD},\"notificationType\":\"${NOTIFICATION_TYPE}\""
  fi
  if [ -n "$AT" ]; then
    PAYLOAD="${PAYLOAD},\"at\":${AT}"
  fi
  PAYLOAD="${PAYLOAD}}"
  curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST -o /dev/null -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "x-acme-token: ${TOKEN}" -H "x-omux-token: ${TOKEN}" -d "$PAYLOAD" "http://localhost:${PORT}/api/status/hook" 2>/dev/null
) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
exit 0

statusline.sh.content:
#!/bin/sh
PORT_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/port"
TOKEN_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/cli-token"
[ -f "$PORT_FILE" ] || exit 0
[ -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ] || exit 0
PORT=$(cat "$PORT_FILE")
TOKEN=$(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")
curl -sf --max-time 2 -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "x-acme-token: ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "x-omux-token: ${TOKEN}" \
  --data-binary @- \
  "http://localhost:${PORT}/api/status/statusline" 2>/dev/null || exit 0

codex-hook.sh.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
PORT_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/port"
TOKEN_FILE="$HOME/.acme-ai/cli-token"
[ -f "$PORT_FILE" ] || exit 0
[ -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ] || exit 0
PORT=$(cat "$PORT_FILE")
TOKEN=$(cat "$TOKEN_FILE")
SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}' 2>/dev/null) || SESSION=""

curl -sS -X POST -o /dev/null \
  -H "x-acme-token: ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "x-omux-token: ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- \
  "http://localhost:${PORT}/api/status/hook?provider=codex&tmuxSession=${SESSION}" 2>/dev/null || true
exit 0

promptEditor.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Acme prompt editor: Claude Code runs it for Ctrl+G. A hand-off file the runtime left for this pane is
# appended to the prompt, so the text arrives as typed and not as a paste; without one the person's editor opens.
# Pane ids repeat across tmux servers, so a pane off the old violet server is keyed by its server too.
dir='@DATA@/prompt-handoff'
key=${TMUX_PANE#%}
socket=${TMUX%%,*}
socket=${socket##*/}
[ -n "$key" ] && [ -n "$socket" ] && [ "$socket" != violet ] && key="$socket-$key"
if [ -n "$key" ] && mv "$dir/$key.txt" "$dir/$key.$$.taking" 2>/dev/null; then
  cat "$dir/$key.$$.taking" >> "$1"
  rm -f "$dir/$key.$$.taking"
  exit 0
fi
editor=${ACME_HUMAN_EDITOR:-vi}
[ "$editor" = "$0" ] && editor=vi
exec sh -c "$editor \"\$@\"" sh "$@"
